'''Tydis Neutronics''' was a company operating on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They owned a cure for the [[Rot]], a disease affecting Nar Shaddaa's poor residents, who were unable to afford it until [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] obtained the cure from the [[Tydis Neutronics Warehouse]] and used it to cure the infected and win their support.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tydis Neutronics appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="SWTOR" />
